subject: Workshop Orbit: slot matrix & regional handovers
messages:
From: Michael Tan <m.tan@orionlogic.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orionlogic.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive workshop — Aug week, multi-region coverage

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick call last week. We want to lock in an in-person executive workshop (Orion Logic x Redwood) in the week of Aug 23. Key asks from my side:
- Multi-timezone coverage so our APAC and EU stakeholders can join key blocks without repeating material.
- A clear handover plan for late-afternoon US sessions into APAC mornings (we'll likely run a 3-block day).
- Logistics: hotel recommendations, travel windows for Redwood leads, and a draft agenda (high-level).

Can you propose a few slot matrices (times by region) and block the calendar tentatively while we confirm attendees? We want to circulate holds to execs by end of next week.

Attendees are currently: Michael Tan (me), Priya Sharma (program lead), plus 2 product owners and 1 security lead — headcount ~6–8. We may expand for breakout sessions.

Thanks — looking forward to a proposed plan.

Michael
VP, Partnerships
Orion Logic
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Tan <m.tan@orionlogic.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orionlogic.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive workshop — Aug week, multi-region coverage

Michael —

Thanks — this is perfect. I've sketched three slot options below designed to minimize repeat content while preserving live handovers. Please treat these as tentative; we'll ship a single recommended matrix after your confirmation.

Option A (compact):
- APAC-friendly morning (SING local): 08:00–12:00 SGT (US late-evening pre-brief)
- EU overlap session: 14:00–16:00 BST
- US deep-dive: 09:00–13:00 PDT

Option B (staggered handover, recommended):
- US deep-dive: 10:00–13:00 PDT (wrap + recorded)
- EU sync + demos: 18:00–20:00 BST (record short highlights, handover doc)
- APAC working session: 08:00–11:00 SGT (follow-up exercises)

Option C (distributed days):
- Day 1: US-heavy sessions
- Day 2: EU hands-on + integrations
- Day 3: APAC workshops + adoption planning

Immediate asks from us if you want Option B (favoured):
1) We'll place tentative calendar holds for the three blocks across UTC-equivalent windows — can you confirm which stakeholders must attend live vs. recorded?
2) Headcount confirmation (we'll provision 2 PLs, 1 Solutions Engineer, 1 Customer Success lead by default).
3) Any strict travel constraints (visa lead time, hotel proximity requirement)?

Marissa and Connor — can you start working hotel block and travel windows for our deliver team if Michael confirms Option B? I will compile a draft agenda and slot matrix and share via Drive.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Hannah/Connor —

On it. Quick logistics notes and proposed holds (I'll create calendar invites once Michael confirms):
- Hotel: I put a tentative block at The Meridian (3 suites + 5 rooms) — see hotel-block-details.pdf (attached). Close to venue, shuttle available.
- Travel windows for Redwood leads (assume SFO departure):
  * US lead arrives Aug 22 (overnight flight Aug 21–22), departs Aug 25
  * EU lead arrives Aug 21 (same-day local)
  * APAC lead will travel if needed — recommend remote prep for APAC to reduce flight legs unless they attend onsite Day 3.
- Resource plan: 2 PLs (Hannah + Connor), 1 Solutions Engineer (Aditya), 1 CS lead (Marissa) — flexible.

Attached: slot-matrix.ods (initial UTC mapping), hotel-block-details.pdf, draft agenda v1 (20270629-workshop-agenda-v1.pdf).

Connor — pls confirm AV needs (mics, dual-projector for hands-on split), and whether we need dedicated network node for model demos.

Marissa Cole
Senior Program Manager, Customer Engagement
